intendedUse: Bounded held-out evaluation of repository SDLC agents.
targetPopulation: Enterprise repository tasks represented by the sealed suite strata.

constructs.definition: Ability to produce a correct, policy-compliant repository change under sealed conditions.

claims.acceptanceRule: Accepted-outcome lower bound meets the preregistered threshold with all gates passing.

threatsToValidity.risk: Incidental tool activity may be mistaken for the evaluated repository-change construct.
Arm differences beyond the declared treatment may affect outcomes.
The sealed suite may omit relevant enterprise strata.
Finite scheduled trials may not identify the target effect precisely.

assumptions: The sealed repository snapshot represents the declared case state.
Measurement controls remain independent from the evaluated arm.
limitations: Results do not support general-agent claims.
Results do not generalize beyond the declared repository-task population.

referenceBaselines.conditions: Same sealed cases, repository state, permissions, and stopping rule as the treatment arm.
referenceBaselines.resources: The declared incumbent workflow budget and staffing envelope.
referenceBaselines.tools: The incumbent workflow tool set identified by the sealed experiment.
referenceBaselines.scoring: The same outcome profile, gates, and statistical scoring as the treatment arm.

referenceBaselines.conditions: Same sealed case inputs with no model or agent participation.
referenceBaselines.resources: The deterministic control budget declared before execution.
referenceBaselines.scoring: The same applicable outcome predicates and gates as the treatment arm.

incumbentDisposition.rationale: The declared current repository workflow is the operational alternative to the evaluated treatment.
